name: Nodexeus Technologies
tagline: We run the infrastructure that has to stay up.
description: Nodexeus builds and operates blockchain nodes, AI agent platforms and the web3 software around them.

principles: specific beats vague — name the failure mode, not the fear
state limits honestly instead of overselling
short, declarative sentences over hedged ones
sampleQuotes: We run the infrastructure that has to stay up.
Anyone can rent you a server. The work is everything after.
Not a tarball and good luck.
We do not publish a blanket uptime guarantee, because one that covers every network and every hardware configuration would be worth nothing.

socialContentPillars: uptime and incident transparency (what broke, what we did)
AI agent and web3 engineering work in production

socialConventions.hashtags: sparingly, only when naming a network or event
socialConventions.emoji: none, or a single one at most
socialConventions.postLength: 1-3 short sentences; threads only when reporting a real incident or upgrade in steps
socialConventions.cta: specific and low-pressure (e.g. 'ask us what that costs'), never hype-driven

onBrand: Base client update landed this week. We're on it across every base-mainnet node we run — no action needed if that's us.
Uptime numbers only mean something next to the incident that tested them. Ask us about the fork we caught at 3am last month.
New: private RPC endpoints for Solana, same operating model as our Ethereum fleet. Talk to an engineer if you're evaluating providers.

offBrand.post: 🚀🚀 Revolutionizing Web3 infrastructure with our CUTTING-EDGE platform!! #blockchain #AI #web3 #innovation #disrupt
offBrand.reason: hype language, emoji stacking, and hashtag stuffing — the voice guide explicitly avoids all three

offBrand.post: We guarantee 99.999% uptime on every network, no exceptions!
offBrand.reason: the brand explicitly refuses blanket uptime guarantees — this contradicts stated positioning

visualCardRules.background: ink (#111114) or white, no gradients beyond the existing chart scale
visualCardRules.logoPlacement: top-left or centered, minimum clearspace = 1x icon height
visualCardRules.typography: GeistSans for headline text on cards
visualCardRules.accentUsage: amber (#fdc700) for at most one focal element per card
